items.title: pCloud confirms password manager hack after suspicious login alerts
items.snippet: The pCloud Pass password manager suffered a cyberattack, with users reporting that unknown devices had connected to their accounts even with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled. [...]
items.summary: pCloud confirms a cyberattack after users reported unknown devices connecting to accounts despite two-factor authentication.
items.why: Review account sessions and investigate unfamiliar logins, including accounts with 2FA enabled.

items.title: New Boston Scientific data breach exposes personal, medical info
items.snippet: Medical technology company Boston Scientific is sending data breach notices to individuals affected by a cyberattack on the firm. [...]
items.summary: Boston Scientific is sending breach notices to individuals affected by a cyberattack, according to the company.
items.why: Review incident communications and assess exposure of personal and medical information.

items.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
items.snippet: A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers. [...]
items.summary: A publicly disclosed Cacti zero-day has a proof-of-concept exploit that allows unauthenticated command execution on vulnerable servers.
items.why: Check Cacti deployments for exposure and prioritize patching or other mitigations.

items.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
items.snippet: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. [...]
items.summary: Hackers reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One platform, amid cyberattacks affecting US government agencies.
items.why: Review cloud access and monitoring for signs of unauthorized activity.

items.title: Your Firewall Isn't Enough: The Hidden Risk of Unmanaged VMs
items.snippet: Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive access permissions can create security blind spots across IT infrastructure. ISPsystem explains how centralized infrastructure management, access controls, and resource lifecycle automation can help reduce these risks. [...]
items.summary: ISPsystem says forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive permissions can create security blind spots.
items.why: Inventory virtual machines, check patch status, and review access permissions.

items.title: Malwarebytes Antivirus: Get 50% off during Black Friday 2026
items.snippet: Malwarebytes' 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale is now live, offering 50% off security subscriptions for individuals, families, and small businesses, including its antivirus software, VPN, identity theft protection, and personal data removal services. [...]
items.summary: Malwarebytes is offering discounted security subscriptions during its 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale.
items.why: Compare security tools against your needs before changing subscriptions.

items.title: Japan’s education ministry discloses breach of government procurement system
items.snippet: Japan’s education ministry disclosed earlier this week that hackers breached its government procurement system, potentially exposing records containing business information and email addresses.
items.summary: Japan’s education ministry disclosed a breach of its government procurement system that may have exposed business information and email addresses.
items.why: Check procurement-system access and assess whether exposed contact information needs protection.

items.title: Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach
items.snippet: German software giant SAP confirmed a cybersecurity incident following reports that hackers infiltrated its software development infrastructure, potentially gaining access to the company’s source code.
items.summary: SAP confirmed a cyber incident following reports of intrusion into its software development infrastructure and possible source-code access.
items.why: Review development-environment access and investigate possible source-code exposure.

items.title: Unique AIM-9X Sidewinders Now Seen On USAF F-35As In The Middle East
items.snippet: It's a mystery why these AIM-9Xs have emerged now, but work has continued on F-35-specific versions with reduced radar reflectivity. The post Unique AIM-9X Sidewinders Now Seen On USAF F-35As In The Middle East appeared first on TWZ .

items.summary: Five European NATO allies are ordering more than 400 CV90 infantry fighting vehicles in a $6-billion deal.

items.title: France kicks off defense-industry pact to build up counter-drone efforts
items.snippet: The wars in Ukraine and the Middle East have been a “quite brutal reality check,” and French forces have an urgent need for counter-drone capabilities, said Alice Rufo, France’s junior minister for the armed forces.
items.summary: France has begun a defense-industry pact to build counter-drone capabilities. A French junior minister said recent wars showed an urgent need.
items.why: The pact reflects a stated operational priority for counter-drone capabilities.

items.title: Photos Show Apparent Stern Block of Japan’s Second ASEV
items.snippet: New photos from JMU’s Isogo shipyard in Yokohama show a large hull block believed to be the stern section of Japan’s second ASEV missile defense ship. The post Photos Show Apparent Stern Block of Japan’s Second ASEV appeared first on Naval News .
items.summary: New photos from a shipyard in Yokohama show a large hull block believed to be the stern section of Japan's second ASEV missile defense ship.
items.why: The apparent ship section offers a geospatial and industrial clue to the vessel's development.

analysis.headline: Security Claims, Military Actions and Political Choices
paragraphs: The top stories span cyber vulnerabilities, military technology, procurement and political or conflict reporting. CISA’s catalog addition and reports of a password-manager attack and a data breach put security issues alongside accounts of weapons and military equipment. The available excerpts do not establish a shared cause.

Several reports hinge on attributed claims: Italy’s foreign minister links a drone to Iran, while the US military describes disabling ships. Taiwan’s election stories also frame policy and party questions through voting. Analysts should keep source claims distinct from confirmed details, especially where the snippets provide little context.

For defenders, the vulnerability catalog item is a prompt to check relevant systems, though its excerpt gives no vulnerability details. For analysts, the stories suggest tracking how military capabilities, procurement, elections and energy policy are discussed. Watch for further information that clarifies the claims and the decisions reported.
takeaways: Keep reported claims distinct from established details.
Check whether systems are affected by cataloged vulnerabilities.
Track how elections and policy choices are framed.
